propositions: Phase 2 removes 827 duplicate bridge-echo comments across three issues (REB-1567, REB-1931, REB-2605) that lack the reconciler marker but contain the truncation suffix, identified by a two-condition conjunctive rule.
Truncated comments are identified by presence of reconciler truncation suffix and absence of reconciler marker, because the marker is appended after the body and cut off by the 32767-character limit.
For each distinct normalized comment body, the oldest copy (lowest Jira comment id) survives; duplicates are deleted only where comment_ids map is empty to avoid orphaning recorded references.

After re-enabling the bridge, the first pass will re-post one copy per distinct truncated comment due to the empty comment_ids map, requiring a final sweep with inverted keep-one logic to preserve the newly-posted copy.

Pre-deletion backups and append-only deletion logs were maintained, and post-deletion reconciliation (backup − deleted = observed) on all three issues proves backup completeness without explicit length assertion.
